human.name: Agent Safety Envelope

human.description: Combine a Gatehouse access decision with the exact city location of a capability without granting permission or executing the route.

human.name: Visitor Guide

human.name: Permit request ticket
human.description: Prepare a human-review ticket for a high-impact city operation while preserving the current Gatehouse deny decision and granting no authority.

human.name: Human review record

human.name: Human review audit ledger
human.description: Create a create-once auditable evidence record linking a permit ticket to its human review without granting permission, changing policy, or executing the action.

human.name: Inactive approval certificate
human.description: Seal an audited human approve decision into an exact-scope inactive certificate without granting runtime permission, activating policy, or executing the action.

human.name: Inactive certificate registry
human.description: Register a sealed inactive approval certificate as create-once evidence without activating policy, granting runtime permission, or executing the approved action.

human.name: Human activation intent
human.description: Prepare an exact-scope human activation intent from a registered inactive certificate without activating policy, granting runtime permission, or executing the action.

human.name: Human activation confirmation
human.description: Record an explicit human confirmation of one exact prepared activation intent while remaining confirmed-not-active and granting no runtime authority.

human.name: Human-confirmed runtime grant
human.description: Issue an exact-scope, single-use local runtime grant after explicit human activation confirmation, without connecting the grant to an executor.

human.name: Runtime grant admission
human.description: Validate an issued runtime grant against the exact active city capability owner without connecting a consumer, consuming the grant, or executing the action.

human.name: Exact read-only command lease
human.description: Narrow an admitted runtime grant to one exact registered read-only command without consuming the grant, connecting a consumer, dispatching a command, or executing an action.
